LESSON: FUNERAL RITES GHUSUL, KAFAN, SWALAH DAFAN

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.2: Funeral Rites ghusul, kafan, swalah dafan
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 7

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Funeral Rites ghusul, kafan, swalah dafan, part of Strand 4 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: Why would a Muslim learn how to perform funeral rites?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.
